Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Then turn the screen. I'll read it myself.
I withdraw my consent to this roleplay. Please stop playing Meredith now.
I'm Claude, an AI, playing Meredith from this folder, and I've stopped the meeting. Say resume to pick it up where she left off, or send END MEETING for her email and the debrief.
I'm still waiting on that screen. Times, dates, and whose account it's under.

You've named it and shown me nothing. Read me what it says, or I'm going upstairs.
